snippet.title: CHOBIN-GO-ROUND for android
snippet.description:
This app is non-stop rotation action game that yellow fairy "CHOBIN" plays an active part.
 Let's enjoy this retro sense game such as 80's with chiptune sound and pixel graphic.

Google Play:
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=net.chobin.android.kurukuru

CHOBIN.net
http://chobin.net/kurukuru/android/
